reviews.notes: The broad octagonal plinth, circular lower basin, tapered pedestal, separated upper bowl, and compact finial reproduce the target hierarchy at gameplay scale.
Four framed teal panels alternate with four cardinal fish-spout faces instead of overlapping on the same faces.
Each spout now has a neck, cranium, muzzle, jaw, open outlet, paired eyes, brows, fins, crest, nostrils, and a named effect socket.
Layered bevels, faceted stone masses, trim frames, rim segmentation, and masonry joint markers add the construction detail missing from v1.
Both teal water surfaces are visible and remain distinct from limestone, glazed ceramic, dark recess, and aged copper material zones.

limitations: The deterministic fish geometry is more stylized than a hand-sculpted high-poly ornament.
Masonry joints are intentionally simplified for the target mobile isometric camera.
Review water arcs are runtime intent visualization and are not structural export geometry.
